name: qlrisk_price_bond_future
title: Price a BondFuture
description:
Price one Bond Future (qlrisk BondFuture).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100000, bond_coupon_pct=6, bond_maturity_years=10 (years), conversion_factor=1, traded_price, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "face_value": 100000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
